summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed an 8-K on September 30, 2026 reporting a routine product-marketing event: the first joint exhibition of its CyPath Lung test under a previously announced federal distribution agreement with AvMEDICAL, an SDVOSB, at the NAVREF Annual Conference in Arlington, Virginia, reaching over 300 physicians, healthcare professionals and VA leaders. The filing contains no transaction, securities offering, or corporate-control event; it is simply an operational press release furnished under Items 8.01 and 9.01. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are implicated, so no special-situation or risk-arb angle applies.
